# Diagnostic Script Source Examples

These examples preserve upstream collection details without installing executable helpers. None grants shell or
cloud permission. Prefer individual scoped read-only commands; collect accepted evidence through the active task.
The `run-ig` example creates privileged debug pods and is a remote mutation, even with a script approval switch.
